description: This file defines an immutable class 'MembershipTableSnapshot' which manages a snapshot of the cluster membership data in Orleans, including versioning, entries, and status evaluation methods.

classes.name: MembershipTableSnapshot
classes.description: Immutable class representing a snapshot of the membership table in Orleans, including logic for updates, status queries, and string representation.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new snapshot from the provided membership table data.

methods.name: Update (with MembershipTableData)
methods.description: Updates the snapshot based on new table data, including versioning.

methods.name: Update (with previous and updated snapshot)
methods.description: Creates a new snapshot by comparing previous and updated snapshot states.

methods.name: Update (private)
methods.description: Internal method to generate a new snapshot with specific version and entries.

methods.name: PreserveIAmAliveTime
methods.description: Ensures the IAmAliveTime is preserved from previous snapshot if it is more recent.

methods.name: GetSiloStatus
methods.description: Determines the status of a given silo address within the snapshot.

methods.name: IsSuccessorTo
methods.description: Checks if the current snapshot is a successor to another snapshot based on version and entries.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the snapshot, including version, silo count, and entries.
